title: Build a platform fire
kid_text: Build on green logs, not on the snow.
safety: Wet rocks can burst. Use dry rocks only.
Never make a fire in a closed tent or snow cave.

steps.text: Lay two layers of green logs.
Make the floor wider than the fire.
Add dry rocks only, never wet ones.
Build the fire on top of that floor.
Leave a hole so fresh air can enter.

mistakes.text: You set the fire on the snow.
